author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Sponsored by Harness

Frame the problem: most FinOps teams are still stuck in visibility mode — just trying to figure out who's spending what and where. But the landscape has changed dramatically with AI workloads. The question is no longer just "what did we spend?" but "can we get ahead of it before it ships?"

Join us for this webinar to learn how leading FinOps teams are evolving from reactive cost visibility to proactive governance — gaining the foresight to manage AI-driven cloud spend before it impacts the business.
title: LF Live Webinar: Shift Left & AI Spend — The Future of FinOps
